import re
from urllib.parse import urljoin
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

# --- Setup ---
data = items[0]['json']
html_content = data['data']
base_url = data.get('base_url', 'https://www.bitovi.com/')

all_articles = data.get('all_articles', [])

# Parse the HTML from the current page
soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser')

# --- Main Scraping Logic ---
articles_this_page = []

article_cards = soup.select('div.bitovi-blog-home-tile')

for card in article_cards:
    #author's name
    author_element = card.select_one('div.blog-tile-author-info')
    author_name = author_element.get_text(strip=True) if author_element else None

    #topic link and name
    topic_element = card.select_one('a[href*="/blog/topic/"]')
    topic_name = topic_element.get_text(strip=True) if topic_element else None
    
    # article link 
    article_link_element = card.select_one('div.blog-tile-details a')
    article_link = urljoin(base_url, article_link_element['href']) if article_link_element else None
    
    title_element = card.select_one('div[class*="hs-blog-post-wrapper"] p')
    title = title_element.get_text(strip=True) if title_element else None
    #  summary
    summary_element = card.select_one('div.blog-content-summary p')
    summary = summary_element.get_text(strip=True) if summary_element else None
   

    if article_link:
        article_data = {
            "url": article_link,
            "title": title,
            "author": author_name,
            "topic": topic_name,
            "summary": summary
        }
        articles_this_page.append(article_data)

new_articles = [article for article in articles_this_page if article not in all_articles]
all_articles.extend(new_articles)

# --- Pagination Logic ---
current_page = data.get('current_page', 1)
page_pattern = re.compile(r'/blog/page/(\d+)')
matches = page_pattern.findall(html_content)
page_numbers = sorted(set(int(x) for x in matches)) if matches else []
has_next = any(n > current_page for n in page_numbers)

# --- Return Structure ---
return [{
    "json": {
        "base_url": base_url,
        "current_page": current_page,
        "all_articles": all_articles,
        "articles_this_page": new_articles,
        "has_next_page": has_next,
        "detected_page_numbers": page_numbers
    }
}]
